title: Sawer
summary: SAW'ER, noun One that saws; corrupted into sawyer. SAW'-FISH, noun A fish of the genus Pristis, which has a long beak or snout, with spines growing like teeth on both edges, and four or five spiracles

inlines.v: SAW'ER, noun One that saws; corrupted into sawyer. SAW'-FISH, noun A fish of the genus Pristis, which has a long beak or snout, with spines growing like teeth on both edges, and four or five spiracles or breathing holes in the sides of the neck.
